summary: Daily bugfix run 4: 5 fixes, built 1.7.96 for 26.1.2 + 26.2 (both OK); jar not copied because the Modrinth folder does not exist, still 1.7.95 in Prism Skyblock; untested in game.
alert: Jar not installed: the Modrinth Skyblock 1.21.8 profile has no mods folder. Use /ship to put 1.7.96 into Prism Skyblock. Jars are in `dungeons-26.2/build/libs` and `dungeons-26.1.2/build/libs`.

fixed.title: Run timers no longer reset when Hypixel re-sends the Dungeon location
detail: `SkyblockLocation.changeLocation` drops a repeat DUNGEON location from the same Hypixel server (`serverName` unchanged) while `BossPhase.midRun()`; before only BossPhase ignored it, so LagTracker, P3TitleFilter, GoldorSection, TerminalTracker, SimonSaysTracker, GateDisplay and about 20 more listeners still reset mid-run.
BossPhase also resets on world change, so a requeue into a new instance (also after a wipe) always starts clean.

fixed.title: Sign calculator only touches Hypixel input signs
fixed.detail: `isInputSign` was `inSkyblock() || ^^^`, so any sign edited in SkyBlock had line 1 like `3-1` or `1/2` replaced by the result (follow-up to the #531 feature). Now only signs whose line 2 has the `^^^` arrows.

fixed.title: Speed sign click boxes leaked onto other signs
fixed.detail: The hit list was global and only refreshed while the speed sign rendered, so after one use, clicking that screen area on a Bazaar or auction sign wrote a crop speed into line 1 and closed it. Click handler now needs the setting, the garden and `isSpeedSign(screen)`; list is cleared when a sign opens.

fixed.title: Hotspot Radar cooldown key was misspelled
fixed.detail: `HOTSPLOT_RADAR` -> `HOTSPOT_RADAR` (NEU item id, cooldown 2s). Shows only if Hypixel sends the ability sound or mana line for it.

fixed.title: Item upload retry backs off during a worker outage
fixed.detail: Follow-up to #548: a failed upload retried and force-synced every 5 s; now 10 s doubling to about 2.5 min, reset on join.

already.title: All other open Bug cards were already fixed and in Testing

open.title: Players get stuck and glitch (Rift mountain top)
open.detail: No repro and nothing in FishMod moves or animates other players (render-state, scale and nametag hooks only). Ask the reporter to run `/fmdev bisect all` and say whether the glitch stops, or send a video.

open.title: Secrets cap on the leaderboard: worker change waiting for your deploy
open.detail: Clamp floors raised in `D:\FishMod-WorkerBoard` (d12a9a3), not deployed. Diff against the live worker before `wrangler deploy`.

open.title: Find a player inside one leaderboard: worker change waiting for your deploy
open.detail: Committed in `D:\FishMod-WorkerBoard` (398a24e), not deployed. Diff against the live worker before `wrangler deploy`.
